label: True
definition: The central factual claim is supported, or the commitment was fulfilled materially as stated and on time.
implementation_rule: Use when high-quality evidence supports the reasonable central takeaway.

label: Mostly True
definition: The central claim held up, with a limited error, qualification, delay, or scope deviation.
implementation_rule: After correcting minor details, the central takeaway remains substantially intact.

label: Misleading
definition: Some material part held up, but missing context, framing, capability, or deadline performance substantially changed the reasonable takeaway.
implementation_rule: Use when adding necessary context materially changes what a reasonable reader would conclude.

label: Unsupported
definition: The claim was presented affirmatively but adequate credible support was not available; the record did not justify a definitive False verdict.
implementation_rule: Use when Musk bears the burden of proof for a specific allegation or capability claim and reliable substantiation is absent.

label: False
definition: Reliable evidence contradicted the central claim, or a mature measurable commitment was unfulfilled or reversed.
implementation_rule: Use only when the evidence is strong enough to contradict the central proposition or show failure of a mature commitment.

label: Unresolved
definition: Credible evidence remained insufficient or materially conflicted, or the statement lacked an objective success threshold.
implementation_rule: Keep visible but exclude from numerator and denominator.

label: Pending
definition: The relevant deadline or explicit condition had not matured by the evaluation date.
implementation_rule: Re-evaluate after the deadline or condition matures.

label: Credibly Contested
definition: One or more credible sources materially challenge the claim.
implementation_rule: Contestation does not itself determine the verdict; evaluate the total evidence.

label: Corrected or Acknowledged
definition: Musk publicly acknowledged an error, clarification, apology, or corrective explanation.
implementation_rule: Preserve the original score while prominently showing the correction.

label: Deleted After Challenge
definition: The original post was deleted after public challenge or scrutiny.
implementation_rule: Deletion is context, not proof of falsity or intent.

label: Repeated After Correction
definition: The same underlying proposition was repeated after a credible correction or adverse resolution.
implementation_rule: Do not create duplicate scored rows unless the later statement is materially distinct; show repetition count instead.

label: Former Affiliation
definition: The claim concerns an organization Musk founded, funded, led, advised, or belonged to but is no longer affiliated with.
implementation_rule: Use related_entity and relationship_to_entity to distinguish historical affiliations from current companies.

label: Repost or Amplification
definition: Musk shared a claim created by another source.
implementation_rule: Score only when accompanying words, framing, or context affirmatively adopts the proposition; a bare repost is not automatically treated as authorship of every statement.
